author: Johnny Harris
description:
Information is Power. 
Join Newpress here: https://newpress.com/

For centuries, elites and the people have been in a battle for who controls information, and who has access to it. Recently, people have been drowning in a sea of algorithmic noise and divisive headlines. 

That’s why we’re launching Newpress - to provide a community where people can see how our journalism works and participate in the process.

One of my upcoming videos is a deep dive investigation into global money laundering - and it’s live NOW for founding members on Newpress. We will also be publishing it on YouTube soon.
